links.outcome: Correlation between model self-reported confidence and answer correctness on specialty exam questions
links.effect: GPT-4o confidence-accuracy correlation weak and non-significant (r = 0.14); GPT-5 significant positive correlation (r = 0.28), surviving Bonferroni correction; mean confidence high for both models.
links.quote: The confidence-accuracy correlation was weak and non-significant for GPT-4o (r = 0.14), whereas GPT-5 demonstrated a statistically significant positive correlation (r = 0.28), which remained significant after correction for multiple testing.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the examination performance and confidence calibration of two LLMs (GPT-4o and a purported GPT-5) on a multiple-choice gastroenterology certification exam without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
